values.note: Booking page: 'Campsite Non-Electric ... Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance.' note: NC State Parks near Gatesville in the northeastern coastal plain, beside the cypress-tupelo millpond; canoe-in and backpack camping elsewhere in the park. --Claude
summary: Still temporarily closed (ncparks.gov: 'Due to pending construction, the family campground at Merchants Millpond will be closed until further notice'; status already recorded). Changed site count (note's 17 -> 20 on the booking site); confirmed 63-ft max.
